title: Governed remote branch clutter retirement with immutable snapshot preservation in susi-harness and push-policy
goal: Implement susi-harness retire-branches (retire_remote_clutter) and native push-policy preservation checks so non-main remote refs/heads/* clutter (including merged and RETIRE-ledger local-agent/* branches when --include-local-agent is set) is preserved as immutable refs/tags/susi-distill/legacy-* tags confirmed on origin before compare-and-swap deletion, while unconditionally protecting refs/heads/main, active claims, and unmerged active agent branches.

results.clippy: cargo clippy --jobs 12 -p xtask -p susi-harness --all-targets --offline --locked -- -D warnings: exit 0
results.tests: susi-harness --lib: 529 passed / 0 failed (git_governor 5/5); susi-harness --bins: 41 passed / 0 failed; xtask --test native_push_policy: 14 passed / 0 failed; xtask --test git_publisher_native_hook: 5 passed / 0 failed
results.guards: lean_core_ceilings 2/2, architecture_tests 44/44, core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins 5/5, no_github_coupling 5/5, orphan_sources 3/3, task_records 3/3

limitations: retire_remote_clutter deletes remote branches only after confirming refs/tags/susi-distill/legacy-* preservation via git ls-remote and skips refs/heads/main, active claims, and unmerged non-RETIRE local-agent/* branches.
